maya (people-ops): Tiny pack of goal + feedback snippets for busy teams. Copy/paste into OKR forms, 1:1 notes, or Slack asks.
maya (people-ops): Manager one-line goal + witnesses:
Goal: Cut per-token inference cost by 15% for standard text route via batching + kernel tweaks.
Measures: cost/token -15% vs baseline; p95 latency <=230ms; no user-facing regressions >0.5%.
Owners/deps: Eng (@owen) + Infra; hiring: backend SWE req if needed.

eli: Can you add a handoff line for cross-team work?
maya (people-ops): Handoff snippet: "Handoff: doc + paired walkthrough; owner for handoff: @NAME; acceptance criteria: checklist + 1 smoke test."

rachel: Self-review micro-format?
maya (people-ops): Self-review bullets (one line each):
- What I shipped: one-liner + link
- Impact: metric or customer signal
- Tradeoffs / blockers encountered
- Next quarter focus: one prioritized item

owen: Fast peer feedback DM?
maya (people-ops): DM-ready: "Hey @NAME, quick favor: 2 things I should KEEP and 1 thing I should CHANGE about our work on PROJECT. One-line each. Thanks!"

eli: Manager coaching script for missed targets?
maya (people-ops): Micro-coach (4 steps): 1) Acknowledge a specific win. 2) Show the metric gap (baseline vs target). 3) Ask what blocked progress and offer 1 concrete support item. 4) Agree next action + date.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: mid-cycle check-ins due 2026-05-12. Submit via https://intranet/reviews/checkins

maya (people-ops): Dropping this into the handbook page and a 1-pager in Drive. Ping me for a Slides handout.
